items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: sometimes me and Pee Wee Hunt, the trombone player, would do a little number together

ctx.x: So we got to know all the guys through that. The Casa Loma Band and all of them. They'd come there every night. They'd come into the Onyx, and sometimes me and Pee Wee Hunt, the trombone player, would do a little number together, you know, a little jive number, just spontaneously, you know.
Well, I was going to ask you, when you started putting the derbies on your head, remember?
